title: Understanding the Logistic Function
text: The logistic function, also known as the sigmoid function, is defined as \( \sigma(z) $$=$$ \frac{1}{1+e**{-z}} \). It maps any real-valued number into the range $$(0,1)$$.

title: Calculate the Linear Combination
text: To find \( \gamma \), we first need to calculate the linear combination \( $$z$$ $$=$$ $$\theta_1$$ \cdot \text{hue} + $$\theta_2$$ \cdot \text{abv} \). Substitute the given values: \( $$\theta_1$$ $$=$$ $$2$$ \), \( $$\theta_2$$ $$=$$ $$1$$ \), \( \text{hue} $$=$$ \frac{1}{4} \), and \( \text{abv} $$=$$ $$-2$$ \).

title: Apply the Sigmoid Function
text: Now that you have \( $$z$$ $$=$$ $$-1.5$$ \), apply the sigmoid function: \( \gamma $$=$$ $$\sigma(-1.5)$$ $$=$$ \frac{1}{1+e**{1.5}} \).

title: Interpret \( \gamma \)
text: The value of \( \gamma \) represents the probability that Billywine is a type $$1$$ wine. Since \( \gamma \approx $$0.1824$$ \), it is unlikely that Billywine is a type $$1$$ wine.
